svg.aria-label: Illustration of economic surplus and midpoint rewards at an agreed price
svg.title: Illustration of economic surplus and midpoint rewards at an agreed price

g.text: Seller cost c=50, buyer value v=100. Move the agreed price p.
Surplus can be positive while midpoint reward is negative. Walking and expiry return zero.
Reward = clip((2p−c−v)/(v−c), −1, 1) for seller; buyer gets its negative.
